body: In order to expedite the trouble-shooting process, please provide colab link or minimal standalone code to reproduce the issue reported here. Thanks!

Hi @ravikyram,

You can reproduce the issue by simply installing tensorflow and calling `saved_model_cli -h` to print its usage.

Using 2.2rc0 on Linux:
```console
virtualenv ./venv_rc0
source ./venv_rc0/bin/activate
pip3 install tensorflow==2.2rc0
saved_model_cli -h
```
yields:
```
usage: saved_model_cli [-h] [-v] {show,run,scan,convert,aot_compile_cpu} ...

saved_model_cli: Command-line interface for SavedModel

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -v, --version         show program's version number and exit

commands:
  valid commands

  {show,run,scan,convert,aot_compile_cpu}
                        additional help
```

Using 2.2rc1 or rc2 on any platform, or rc0 on MacOS or Windows:
```console
deactivate
virtualenv ./venv_rc1
source ./venv_rc1/bin/activate
pip3 install tensorflow==2.2rc1
saved_model_cli -h
```
yields:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/ubuntu/venv_rc1/bin/saved_model_cli", line 5, in <module>
    from tensorflow.python.tools.saved_model_cli import main
  File "/home/ubuntu/venv_rc1/lib/python3.6/site-packages/tensorflow/python/tools/saved_model_cli.py", line 51, in <module>
    from tensorflow.python.tools import saved_model_aot_compile
ImportError: cannot import name 'saved_model_aot_compile'
```
@marcoadurno thanks for reporting, we are looking into this, and will address it for the next release candidate.
Are you satisfied with the resolution of your issue? Yes No
(thanks so much for the clean repro!)
